payload.rationale: Brief sets journey_stage dreaming, service_link /destinations, Wedded Concierge secondary, matching the services.md early-stage rule and the cluster sister posts. Weighted enquiry likelihood is 1.7 and the panel chair said not to add sales copy to chase it, so the primary is the low-pressure destinations hub, not an enquiry, and no new claims are added. The current marker sits before the checklist, where nothing has raised the 'where' question yet; the closing sentence 'Where you ask, and later where you marry, are the next decisions' raises it, so the marker moves directly below it and that sentence's inline /destinations link is dropped to avoid a duplicate primary link. The panel's must_fix (Advisor customs line reading as an upsell) and the fee worry are already resolved in 08-final.md: the Advisor line now sits in the closing with a conditional, and the fee-in-writing line closes the section; both are left as set. Deferred items (fee model, commission, deposits, named Advisor, scale) are not stated. No prices. /magazine exists (link-map, type magazine, topic lead magnet) and services.md lists it as the early-stage magnet. Suggested future magnet, not placed (exists: false on the site): a printable 'take this to your jeweller' diamond shortlist checklist built from the post's checklist section. All targets confirmed in content-system/seo/link-map.csv (last_seen 2026-10-20).
